config.greeting: Thanks for calling, this is the billing line.
replies: I can see the duplicate charge on that order. One moment while I reverse it.
The reversal is through. Your confirmation number is RC four four one seven.
You are welcome. The confirmation is on its way to your email too. Goodbye.

traits.personality: Dev, 34, calling from a train platform. In a hurry, talks over slow answers, background noise comes and goes.

scenario.instructions: My card was charged twice for the same order this morning. I need the duplicate charge reversed and a confirmation number before my train arrives. Please be quick about it.
